title: GuardDecideOutput
description: The one JSON document `trooth guard decide --json` prints on stdout when it decides or declines to: a GuardDecision when the policy covers the tool (exit 0 allow, 20 hold, 21 deny), or a GuardNotCovered when it does not (exit 0). A usage error prints the CLI's error document instead ({"ok": false, "error": "...", "exit": 2}), as every command does.
